sub_answers.text: The Local Government Act 1972 created a two-tier system of metropolitan counties and districts covering Tyne and Wear, with effect from 1974. [d67582869s1p0] Newcastle was a district of the Tyne and Wear metropolitan county starting in 1974. [d67582869s1p0] The Local Government Act 1985 later abolished the metropolitan counties, with metropolitan districts taking on most of their former county powers as metropolitan boroughs. [d67582869s1p0]
